title: SpaceX's first results put Musk's AI spending under Wall Street microscope
excerpt: SpaceX's first earnings report since its record-breaking IPO will provide an early gauge of whether Starlink's profits can sustain the company's rapidly grow...
content_html:
By Akash Sriram

August 3 (Reuters) - SpaceX's first earnings report since its record-breaking IPO will provide an early gauge of whether Starlink's profits can sustain the company's rapidly growing spending on AI and space ventures.

Due after the market closes on Tuesday, the results will give SpaceX's limited pool of public investors their first chance ‌to judge whether the financial case behind the company's lofty valuation supports CEO Elon Musk's vision of a powerhouse spanning AI, space and telecommunications.

Musk has pitched AI ‌as SpaceX's future growth engine, with ambitions extending beyond renting compute capacity to other companies to developing frontier models, consumer and enterprise software, and, eventually, data centers in space. But until its AI business and Starship launch operations can ​stand on their own, Musk plans to use Starlink's profits to bankroll both ventures, a strategy critics argue is unsustainable.

"Starlink is executing beautifully, but it cannot single-handedly fund a $30 billion annualized AI capex program," said Will Rhind, founder and CEO of GraniteShares, an asset manager that offers ETFs tied to SpaceX stock performance.

Analysts expect the AI business to nearly triple to $2.33 billion in the April-June quarter, up sharply from 12.5% growth in the prior quarter, according to LSEG-compiled data. Starlink growth is also expected to accelerate to 52.6% from 31.6%, driven mainly by expansion into more countries.

SpaceX's AI expansion consumed $7.72 ‌billion in the January-March quarter, accounting for about three-quarters of the ⁠company's total capital spending. Analysts expect SpaceX to report capital expenses of nearly $14.05 billion in the April-June quarter. Capital spending in the AI segment is expected to surge more than six times to $10.2 billion from the same period last year, according to Visible Alpha data.

SpaceX shares have pulled back sharply ⁠since the company's $86 billion IPO in June, as investors questioned whether its lofty valuation of 77 times expected revenue can be justified.

The stock could face additional pressure from the expiry of SpaceX's post-IPO lock-up period starting August 6, which may unleash a wave of insider and early-investor shares on the market.

Investors will also be keen to hear Musk's comments on a potential merger between SpaceX and Tesla after a media ​report ​emerged last week that executives at his EV company had been told to prepare for a separation of ​its China business ahead of a potential deal. Musk dismissed the report ‌as "fake news," but he had previously declined to dismiss the possibility, citing growing overlap between the companies.

content_html_zh:
通过阿卡什·斯里拉姆

8 月 3 日（路透社）——SpaceX 自破纪录的 IPO 以来的首份收益报告将提供一个初步衡量星链的利润是否能够维持该公司在人工智能和太空企业方面快速增长的支出的指标。

周二收盘后，该结果将让 SpaceX 有限的公众投资者第一次有机会判断该公司高估值背后的财务状况是否支持首席执行官埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 打造横跨人工智能、太空和电信的强国愿景。

马斯克将人工智能视为 SpaceX 未来的增长引擎，其雄心不仅限于向其他公司出租计算能力，还包括开发前沿模型、消费者和企业软件，以及最终开发太空数据中心。 但在其人工智能业务和星舰发射业务能够独立之前，马斯克计划利用星链的利润为这两家企业提供资金，批评者认为这一战略是不可持续的。

GraniteShares 的创始人兼首席执行官 Will Rhind 表示：“Starlink 执行得很好，但它无法单独为 300 亿美元的年度人工智能资本支出计划提供资金。”GraniteShares 是一家提供与 SpaceX 股票表现挂钩的 ETF 的资产管理公司。

根据 LSEG 汇编的数据，分析师预计 4 月至 6 月季度人工智能业务将增长近两倍，达到 23.3 亿美元，较上一季度 12.5% 的增幅大幅增长。 Starlink 的增长预计也将从 31.6% 加速至 52.6%，这主要是由于向更多国家扩张的推动。

1 月至 3 月季度，SpaceX 的人工智能扩张消耗了 77.2 亿美元，约占该公司总资本支出的四分之三。 分析师预计 SpaceX 在 4 月至 6 月这个季度的资本支出将接近 140.5 亿美元。 Visible Alpha 数据显示，人工智能领域的资本支出预计将比去年同期激增六倍以上，达到 102 亿美元。

自 6 月份 860 亿美元的 IPO 以来，SpaceX 股价大幅回落，原因是投资者质疑其 77 倍预期收入的高估值是否合理。

SpaceX 的 IPO 后禁售期从 8 月 6 日开始到期，该股可能面临额外压力，这可能会在市场上引发一波内部人士和早期投资者的股票。

上周有媒体报道称，马斯克的电动汽车公司高管已被告知在潜在交易之前准备剥离其中国业务，投资者也将热衷于听到马斯克对 SpaceX 和特斯拉之间可能合并的评论。 马斯克将该报道斥为“假新闻”，但他此前拒绝否认这种可能性，理由是两家公司之间的重叠越来越大。
